Handicap

Why use the WHS™ (World Handicap System™?

WHS™ was developed by the USGA® and the R&A. It’s the standard handicap system in golf. If you want to compete in regional state associations or events that require a WHS™ handicap ID (e.g. GHIN®#), then this is for you.

We allow golfers to link their handicap ID (e.g. GHIN®#) for Free! Scores will be synced with the USGA® servers to calculate their handicap.

However, to obtain a new handicap ID (e.g. GHIN®#) you will need to purchase it directly with the USGA® or the appropriate association.
